name: Community contacts
description: An address book your whole community shares — the venues, suppliers and people you keep coming back to.
long_description:
Give your community one address book, rather than a copy of the florist's number in every initiative.

Keep a contact here once and link to it from the work in any initiative: the deposit task, the delivery event, the contract file. Every member can look them up; a guest sees only the ones shared with them.

Removing the plug-in sends its contacts to the trash, so nothing is lost by accident.
